title: Practice 7: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Том ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) как топор.
exercises.why: **плавает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
exercises.prompt: Tom can swim no more than a stone can.

exercises.q: Девочка любила ___ (лазать — to climb, there and back or in general) по деревьям.
Масло ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) на воде.
exercises.why: **плавает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).

exercises.q: Мы ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) под парусом.
exercises.why: **плавали** — past tense (plural) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).

exercises.q: Ленивцы хорошо ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general).
exercises.why: **плавают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).

exercises.q: Том ___ (ползать — to crawl, there and back or in general) под колючей проволокой.
exercises.why: **ползал** — past tense (masculine) of ползать: many-directions verb (one direction: ползти).
exercises.prompt: Tom crawled under the barbed wire.

exercises.q: По моим рукам ___ (ползать — to crawl, there and back or in general) божья коровка.
exercises.why: **ползала** — past tense (feminine) of ползать: many-directions verb (one direction: ползти).
exercises.prompt: A ladybug was crawling along my arm.

exercises.q: Они ___ (бежать — to run, one way) в сад, чтобы спастись от этих кровожадных собак.
exercises.why: **бежали** — past tense (plural) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).
exercises.prompt: They ran into the garden to save themselves from those blood-thirsty hounds.

exercises.q: Пингвины хорошо ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general)?
exercises.why: **плавают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).

exercises.q: Перестань ___ (таскать — to drag, there and back or in general) у меня предложения!
Моя собака любит ___ (гонять — to drive, chase, there and back or in general) белок.
Том ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) с ламантинами.
exercises.why: **плавал** — past tense (masculine) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).

exercises.q: Том ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) с китовой акулой.
exercises.why: **плавал** — past tense (masculine) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
exercises.prompt: Tom swam with a whale shark.

exercises.q: Некоторых девушек ___ (гонять — to drive, chase, there and back or in general), как скот.
exercises.why: **гоняли** — past tense (plural) of гонять: many-directions verb (one direction: гнать).
exercises.prompt: Some girls were chased like cattle.

exercises.q: Builders, like my cousin, often have to carry heavy materials to site.
exercises.ru: Строителям, как и моему двоюродному брату, часто приходится ___ тяжести на стройплощадку.

exercises.q: Наши собаки, пудель и такса, ___ (бегать — to run, there and back or in general) по двору.
exercises.why: **бегают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of бегать: many-directions verb (one direction: бежать).
exercises.prompt: Our dogs, a poodle and a dachshund, are running around the yard.

exercises.q: Я ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) один-два раза в неделю.
exercises.why: **плаваю** — present tense (1st person singular) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
exercises.prompt: I swim once or twice a week.

exercises.q: Я ___ (плавать — to swim, float, sail, there and back or in general) три-четыре раза в неделю.
exercises.why: **плаваю** — present tense (1st person singular) of плавать: many-directions verb (one direction: плыть).
exercises.prompt: I swim three or four times a week.

exercises.q: There hasn't been much progress in the investigation. The murderer is still at large, and the police still in the dark.
exercises.why: **бродит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of бродить: many-directions verb (one direction: брести).
exercises.ru: В расследовании пока нет особых подвижек. Убийцу всё ещё ищут, полиция по-прежнему ___ наощупь.
